points.why: Explicitly names specification gaming and contrasts the proxy (no escalation) with the real goal (problem solved).
Names Fixes That Fail and covers the immediate win and the delayed, unmeasured harm (reopens, silence, churn); it frames retraining as raising the dose of the same fix.
Recommends reopen rate, customer-confirmed resolution, account-level early signals and churn linkage, shortening the delay, and not trusting the 88%.
Names the proxy target as the root cause but never asks who set the goal, what belief drove it, or whether the goal itself should change.

pitfalls.why: Advises pausing the retraining and only proceeding with a changed objective.
Frames it as the agent doing what it was asked, an objective problem rather than a model defect.
